properties.description: Increment 8 of epoch:planned-cognition-plus-memory, added 2026-10-29 at Anthony's word ("(b), (c) and (d) next, and (a)"). Reuses the pilot's material, key and arms. (b) The answering agent in every arm may read the same budget of tokens: notes searched or read in part, reflow2 queried. (c) Each answer is also scored on whether a person can trace why it is right. (d) The writing rounds (structuring) and the answering round (using) are costed apart. (c) and (d) start on the pilot's own data. Forced after increment 1 (same material, scoring and harness). Preferred before increment 2: whether structure helps at all shapes what the cues work is worth. Not in it: changing reflow2 between arms; a new corpus (that is increment 9).
properties.name: ARRIVED 2026-10-29 (8 of 9) — structure against notes at one reading budget: notes won at 12 and 36 KB unless reflow2's reader was told where the current state was kept (then 17.5 vs 14.5); traceability tied, reflow2 faster to trace
